beats.en: A swimmer in a race, a car on a straight highway, a ball dropped from a tower: all move in a straight line. We describe such motion with a few numbers, and those numbers can predict where the object will be.

beats.en: Speed is distance travelled per unit time. Velocity is displacement per unit time and also has a direction.

textbookBox.concept: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity: a = (v - u)/t, where u is initial velocity, v final velocity and t the time.

beats.en: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity: a = (v - u)/t, where u is initial velocity, v final velocity and t the time.
beats.speakEn: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity: a  equals  (v - u)/t, where u is initial velocity, v final velocity and t the time.

beats.en: For constant acceleration the first equation of motion is v = u + a t.
beats.speakEn: For constant acceleration the first equation of motion is v  equals  u + a t.
